meta.title: Phone bridge
meta.description: Forwards one sentence from the phone channel into a pinned session, refusing with 409 when no session is bound, and hosts channel-server from the "语音通道" settings panel: runtime status, start and stop, session binding, a 6-digit pairing code, paired devices, the voice provider with a masked API key, and the last dozen log lines. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only; the panel API accepts same-origin local requests only and never logs message text or keys.
